value_label: of every KAS that will ever exist is already mined
headline: the supply story is *almost over*.

panes.title: SUPPLY ALREADY ISSUED
panes.sub: share of the maximum, measured today

post.x: 96.39 percent of every KAS that will ever exist is already mined. 1,036,420,062 KAS are still to come, and 99 percent is reached in may 2028 at the current schedule. what comes after keeps halving every twelve months.
post.reply: the full emission schedule is on kaspapulse.com/kaspa-halving.html. the remaining amount shrinks and never quite reaches the maximum.
